verdict.rationale: The public Kong/insomnia GitHub repository ships an Apache License 2.0 LICENSE file, and the README's License section states Apache-2.0 (insomnia-gh-3). The repository itself is publicly readable (insomnia-gh-1, insomnia-gh-2), so the source can be read under an OSI-approved open license. A 2016 community comment calling it 'not open source' (insomnia-comm-3) predates this licensing and does not contradict the current repository. Missing for 10: recent independent corroboration that the open-source repo covers the full shipped app, including cloud and enterprise features.
